row.note: a finding of the designated Wise Authority body is one row cosigned under the body's own declared protocol, as any cosigned act of a group; the denominator is the full seated roster, never the live subset; a counted row under the hold of 3.3.4
row.standing_set: the designated body's full seated roster, counted as its declared protocol states
